gloss: second volume; last volume (of a two- or three-part work)

definitions.explanation: The final volume of a book or work published in two or three parts. The pair of {上巻|じょうかん} (first volume).

examples.japanese: {下巻|げかん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{読|よ}んでいない→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
examples.english: I haven't read the second volume yet.

examples.japanese: {下巻|げかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{発売|はつばい}→発売：04315_hatsubai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しみ→楽しみ：01651_tanoshimi⟧にして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I'm looking forward to the release of the second volume.

examples.japanese: {下巻|げかん}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{読|よ}み→読む：00426_yomu⟧⟦{終|お}わった→終わる：00567_owaru⟧とき、⟦{物語|ものがたり}→物語：03634_monogatari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{全体|ぜんたい}→全体：03314_zentai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ようやく⟦{理解|りかい}→理解：03674_rikai⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: When I finished reading through the second volume, I finally understood the story as a whole.

notes:
Used for the second (or final) volume of a two- or three-part book set. The pair is ⟦{上巻|じょうかん}→上巻：28431_joukan⟧ (first volume); in three-part sets, {中巻|ちゅうかん} sits between them.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {下巻|げかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧: read the second volume
- {下巻|げかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧: buy the second volume
- ⟦{上巻|じょうかん}→上巻：28431_joukan⟧・{下巻|げかん}⟦セット→セット：03853_setto⟧: first-and-second volume set

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{上巻|じょうかん}→上巻：28431_joukan⟧: first volume — the pair of {下巻|げかん}
- {中巻|ちゅうかん}: middle volume — used only in three-part sets
- {最終巻|さいしゅうかん}: final volume — used for multi-volume series of any length
